4353.title: Reconnect state prevents primary queue submission
4353.rootCauseOneLine: Primary submission switches to an unavailable steer callback during host reconnect and host wait states.
4353.proposedFix: Keep queue submission available when steering is unavailable; separately invalidate thread runtime on session open.
4353.caveats: Component routing reproduced twice; browser appearance and live reconnect recovery not verified. Complete fix spans two subsystems.
